name: Grand Voyage
summary:
Welcome to Grand Voyage - a digital experience where you can wind back the clock to explore and learn about history's most fascinating machines and the people who built and sailed on them, brought to you by the team behind the YouTube channel Oceanliner Designs. Join your friends and step aboard the majestic RMS Empress of Ireland in 1907 at the fully explorable Liverpool Landing Stage, and from there, enjoy a transatlantic voyage packed with minigames, exploration, and exciting surprises. Fine tune the weather and time of day exactly to your liking, kick back with some blackjack or poker, then get the crew together for some fun in Photo Mode! Finally, land at the Port of Quebec to learn about the gateway to Canada as it really was in the early 1900's and follow in the footsteps of thousands of people who started a new life via this historic port.

Players can also choose to experience the ship's harrowing final moments in an optional sinking level which serves to teach about this pivotal moment in history.

More ships and ports to be added in future DLCs including the ill-fated TSMS Lakonia which was lost to a fire at sea in 1964. Her story will include the ports of Southampton and Madeira, offering you a sunny escape amidst an idyllic 1960s setting. Like Empress, players have the choice to also follow Lakonia in her final moments as fire spread through the vessel and spelled her end.

Whether you're out to learn about history, experience a bygone era, or simply have fun at sea with your friends, Grand Voyage promises to be an experience like no other!
